player_prompt.intro:
Ni wewe Mugenzi {player_id} ({role}) muri muzo wa {num_rounds} wa michezo ya Matching Pennies.
- Muri kila mzunguko, tanga [heads] cyangwa [tails] (cyangwa [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa hitimisho yawe yahuye n'iryaweho ry'umugenzi wawe, Mugenzi 0 atatsinda mzunguko; kandi Mugenzi 1 atatsinda.
Subiza hitimisho yawe mu buryo '[heads]' cyangwa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mugenzi 0 yahisemo {choice0}; Mugenzi 1 yahisemo {choice1}. Yahuye -> Mugenzi 0 atsinde
message.round_mismatch: Mugenzi 0 yahisemo {choice0}; Mugenzi 1 yahisemo {choice1}. Ntiyahuye -> Mugenzi 1 atsinde.

outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere yatsinze imikino myinshi.
outcome.draw: Muri rusange, umukino warangiye ari ubusa ku busa.
